item.title: Fiber v3 Is Here: Are 99 Compile Errors Worth It?
item.description: Fiber v3 shipped in February and reached v3.5.0: fiber.Ctx implements context.Context, Bind unifies parsing, QUERY is first-class, and a migration CLI does the boring work. I ran the whole upgrade on Go 1.26.4 — what the CLI automates, where it breaks, and why cancellation never travels through c
